Class Abilities

1st Level

Divine Protection

  • Effect: Permanent passive aura — +2 AC and +2 on all saves against evil creatures. Summoned and conjured evil creatures cannot make physical contact with the Paladin; their natural weapon attacks fail and they recoil.
  • Good elementals and outsiders are immune to this effect
  • Immune to all diseases of any origin.
  • Detect Evil: concentrate for one round while facing a target within 60ft — innate ability, no spellcasting involved. Usable as often as desired.
  • Aura of Courage (6th level): immune to fear (magical or otherwise). Allies within the aura's range gain +4 on saves vs fear — see the Paladin Progression Table (10ft at 6th, 30ft at 15th, 50ft at 20th).

Lay on Hands

  • Effect: Heal 2 HP per Paladin level once per day — used on self or one other, the total cannot be split among multiple recipients.
  • Cure Disease: cure any disease by touch, no check required — uses per week in the Paladin Progression Table.
  • Divine Healing (12th level): once per week, completely cure all diseases, blindness, deafness, HP damage, temporary ability damage, poison, feeblemind, and mental disorders caused by spells or injury — all at once, single application. Does not restore permanently drained ability scores.

Smite Evil

  • Effect: Advantage on one attack roll, plus flat +1 damage per Paladin level. Uses per day: see the Paladin Progression Table.
  • Smite can be used against any foe, regardless of alignment

3rd Level

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As the Cleric's Turn Undead, up to 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day, but counting as a Cleric 2 levels lower than your Paladin level. Turn DC = 10 + half that level (minimum 1) + Charisma modifier.
  • A 3rd level Paladin turns as a 1st level Cleric, a 5th level Paladin as a 3rd level Cleric, and so on
  • Destruction applies from 8th effective turning level, if the undead's Level is no more than half that level

4th Level

Divine Mount

  • Effect: Call a divinely-blessed warhorse (medium-sized Paladin) or war pony (small-sized Paladin) — exceptionally intelligent, strong, and loyal. It uses the Warhorse, Light (or Warpony) statistics in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue, with maximum HP.
  • If the mount dies, a year and a day must pass before another can be called

5th Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Begins casting divine spells per the Paladin Spells Per Day table. Charisma is your casting stat; spell save DC = 10 + half your Paladin level (minimum 1) + Charisma modifier.

7th Level — Extra Attack

  • Extra Attack: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

8th Level

Blessed Weapon

  • Effect: Your weapon counts as magical for overcoming resistance, and deals an extra 1d6 radiant damage against evil creatures.

13th Level

Bequeath Virtue

  • Effect: Imbue a small beautiful item (flower, silk garment, coin, etc.) with healing grace — the recipient heals at double rate while resting, up to half the Paladin's HP before the item wilts.
  • A dying creature holding it is stabilised at once
  • One virtuous item per day
  • Each use costs 1 temporary Constitution (returns in one day; magical healing doesn't accelerate this)
  • The Paladin cannot use these items personally
  • At 18th level it returns characters from −1 to −7 HP to 0 HP
  • At 20th level it returns characters from −1 to −9 HP to 0 HP; it can also imbue items with an ageing reversal — a willing target sleeps for one year and returns 5 years younger. Costs the Paladin 5 temporary Constitution, each point taking 1 month to recover

Divine Intervention

  • Effect: Uses per week: see the Paladin Progression Table. Call on your deity for one of three effects.
  • (1) Reroll any one die result (attack/damage/save/turn undead/attribute check)
  • (2) Advantage on all your attack rolls and double weapon damage dice for 1 round (flat modifiers are not doubled)
  • (3) Halve all damage suffered this round

15th Level

  • Charisma Bonus: permanent +1 Charisma

18th Level

Aura of Devotion

  • Effect: You and allies within your Aura of Courage range have Advantage on saves against charm.

20th Level

Divine Will

  • Effect: Once per month, compel any creature that can hear your voice to take up a cause you name. Affected creatures act as if under a Geas (Will save against your Class Save DC, to resist). Lasts days equal to Paladin level.
  • Does not affect inherently evil creatures or player characters

24th Level

Cleanse Soul

  • Effect: Constrain a target (it is Restrained and unable to act) for rounds equal to its Level, and succeed on a Charisma check (d20 + Charisma modifier) against DC = 8 + the target's Level. If successful: read their full state of mind; detect alignment; pierce illusions and disguises; read surface thoughts and deep memories; detect charm and enchantment effects.
  • May then attempt an exorcism — target makes a Will save against your Class Save DC, or succumbs
  • Inherently evil creatures (demons, vampires, devils) are destroyed; lycanthropes are cured; undead gain eternal rest or are destroyed if they were evil in life
  • Any creature that resists expels the Paladin from its mind and can never be targeted again
  • The Paladin must rest immediately after for 1 hour per Level of the creature — bedridden and helpless during this time

Kits: Deity-Based

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Paladin folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Paladin Kits follow the same deity structure as Cleric Kits — each Kit is tied to a specific deity whose cause the Paladin champions. Paladin Granted Powers lean martial rather than priestly: blessings for the champion, not the congregation.

The Tarielian Pantheon

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
Lathander (The Dawning Light)Mace, HeavyOnce/day: declare a Smite on an undead creature: on a hit, the target must make a Will save against your Class Save DC or be destroyed outright rather than just damaged. Advantage on saves vs necromantic effects.
Chauntea (The Earth's Bloom)SickleOnce/day: cause plants within 20ft to entangle all enemies (Fortitude save or restrained 1 min). Advantage on Wisdom checks in natural environments.
Eldath (The Verdant Peace)StaffOnce/day: calm all hostile creatures within 30ft for 1 minute (Will save negates). Advantage on saves vs charm and enchantment.
Sune (The Full Bloom)WhipAdvantage on Persuasion. Once/day: one creature within 30ft that can see you is Charmed by you for 1 minute (Will save negates; it saves again whenever you or your allies harm it). Lay on Hands also ends the Charmed condition.
Lliira (The Heart of Joy)DartAura of Courage also gives Advantage on saves against charm. Once/day, as an action: you and every ally within 30ft end the Frightened condition and gain Advantage on saves against fear and charm for 1 minute.
Selûne (The Moonlit Veils)MorningstarOnce/day: enter a willing creature's dream during a long rest and communicate freely within it. Advantage on Insight checks. Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your morningstar makes a Will save or cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
Tymora (The Fortunate Harvest)Sword, ShortAdvantage on initiative. Once/day: you or an ally within 30ft rerolls one d20 roll just made and keeps the new result.
Brigh (The Crafted Turn)Hammer, LightOnce/day: repair a broken weapon or armour to full functionality instantly. Advantage on Craft/Smith checks. Once per encounter, as part of your action, temper an ally's weapon or armour by touch: +1 to hit or +1 AC for 1 minute.
Torm (The Enduring Duty)GreatswordAura of Courage extends to allies within 30ft from 1st level rather than 6th. Once/day: grant all allies within 30ft advantage on their next attack roll.
Helm (The Vigilant End)Sword, BastardDivine Protection's AC bonus against evil increases to +4. Once/day: grant a touched creature +4 AC for 1 minute.
Tyr (The Winter's Justice)Hammer, WarOnce/day: bind a target to a sworn oath (Will save negates). The target cannot knowingly break the oath without suffering disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. Advantage on Persuasion to enforce contracts. Your Smite binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
Ilmater (The Winter's Solace)CestusLay on Hands heals an additional +2 HP per Paladin level. Once/day: use Divine Healing on a target without expending the weekly use.

Other Deities

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
MystraDaggerOnce/day: use Divine Intervention's reroll option without expending the weekly use. Advantage on all Knowledge/Lore checks.
SilvanusMaulOnce/day: speak with plants and animals for 10 minutes. Advantage on all Tracking checks. Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your maul makes a Reflex save or its speed is halved until its next turn.
AbadarCrossbow, LightAdvantage on checks to appraise, bargain or spot a forgery, and on saves against charm. Once/day: compel a creature to honour a contract it agreed to (Will save negates).
The Raven QueenScytheImmune to death effects. Once/day: touch a willing creature and place them in suspended animation for up to 1 hour.
UmberleeTridentOnce/day: create a 30ft wave: creatures in a line make Fortitude save or are pushed 15ft and knocked prone. Advantage on all checks involving water or storms.
Drake (Drakaenar)Axe, Two-HandedOnce/day when reduced to 0 HP or below: make one final attack before falling. Advantage on saves against death effects.

Deities of Other Peoples

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Paladin folder. Drag one onto your character.

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
CorellonSword, LongOnce/day: teleport up to 60ft to a location you can see. Advantage on saves vs charm and sleep.
EilistraeeSword, BroadOnce/day: remove the blinded condition or dispel magical darkness in a 30ft radius. Advantage on Perception in low-light conditions.
LolthCat-O-Nine-TailsAdvantage on Stealth underground. Once/day: webs fill a 20ft radius within 60ft; each creature there makes a Reflex save or is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Your Smite against a Restrained creature deals +1d6 poison damage.
MoradinHammer, WarOnce/day: shape stone within 10ft into any simple form. Advantage on Perception checks underground or in stone structures. +1 AC while standing on natural stone or underground.
GruumshSpearAdvantage on Intimidation. Once/day: when your Smite hits, the target also makes a Will save or is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
MaglubiyetAxe, BattleAdvantage on initiative. Once/day: the Paladin and up to 4 allies may move their full speed without triggering opportunity attacks for 1 round.
AnnamMace, LargeOnce/day: perfectly recall any event witnessed, including specific words spoken. Advantage on checks to research or recall historical information. Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a creature you fought in an earlier encounter.
BahamutGlaiveChoose acid, cold, fire or lightning at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it, and your Smite deals +1d6 damage of that type. Advantage on saves against fear.
TiamatPick, HeavyAdvantage on Intimidation. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it, and your Smite deals +1d6 damage of that type.
Zindel of Mournas (Son of the Watcher)Sword, BastardAura of Courage reaches 10ft further. Once/day: when an ally within 30ft is hit by an attack, you take the damage instead, reduced by your Charisma modifier.
Daeric Khyrmin (The Phoenix Prince)Sword, LongAdvantage on Performance. Once/day: for 1 minute, while you wear light or no armour and wield a one-handed blade, add your Charisma modifier to your AC.

The Elemental Lords

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
AkadiFlail, HeavyOnce/day: call a lightning strike on a target within 60ft (3d6, Reflex save for half). Advantage on saves vs weather and elemental effects.
GrumbarClub+1 AC while standing on natural stone or earth. Once per encounter, as part of your action, the ground within 20ft becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn.
IstishiaHammer, WarAdvantage on Swim checks, and you can hold your breath ten times as long. Once/day: a 15ft-radius surge of water within 60ft puts out non-magical fire and pushes each creature in it 10ft away (Fortitude save negates the push).
KossuthFlail, LightSmite deals additional +1d6 fire damage. Once/day: create a 15ft cone of fire (2d6, Reflex save for half). Advantage on saves vs cold.

Evil Deities

  • Paladins of an evil deity (the Evil Deities table, plus Lolth, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet and Tiamat): Divine Protection and Detect Evil work against good creatures instead (as Detect Good). Their oath follows that god's tenets, and betraying the patron makes them Forsaken at once.
DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
AsmodeusSword, RapierOnce/day: force a bargain to be honoured (Will save negates). Any creature that breaks a contract made in the Paladin's presence suffers disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. Once per encounter, as part of your action, offer terms to a creature within 30ft: it makes a Will save or cannot attack you until your next turn.
BaneMorningstarOnce/day: frighten all enemies within 15ft (Will save negates) for 1 minute. Advantage on Intimidation.
BhaalDaggerOnce/day: Smite deals maximum damage automatically (no roll) if the target is below half HP. Advantage on Perception checks against wounded or fleeing creatures.
CyricSword, ShortOnce/day: force belief in a lie for an hour (Will save negates). Advantage on Deception, and you can Feint as the Feint feat describes.
MyrkulScytheTurn Undead can instead control undead rather than destroy — controlled undead follow the Paladin's commands for 1 hour. Once/day: briefly speak with a corpse.
SharDaggerOnce/day: snuff all nonmagical light within 30ft for 10 minutes. Advantage on Stealth in darkness.
MaskSword, ShortOnce/day: become invisible for 1 round in shadow. Smite can be used without revealing the Paladin's position if attacking from concealment.
NocticulaWhipOnce/day: convert damage dealt this round into HP for the Paladin (equal to half damage dealt). Advantage on saves vs charm and fear.
Shune the VileDaggerOnce/day: plant a false memory in a touched creature (Will save negates). Advantage on checks to conceal true intent. Advantage on initiative.
AurilAxe, BattleSmite deals additional +1d6 cold damage and halves target's movement speed for 1 round. Resistance 5 to cold damage.
TharizdunImprovised weaponOnce/day: stun a target for 1 round (Will save negates). Advantage on Intimidation checks using unsettling presence.
  • All other archdevils and demon lords (Mephistopheles, Orcus, Graz'zt, Demogorgon, Baphomet, Yeenoghu) are explicitly excluded here — reserved for Warlock patrons instead.

Paladin Spells Per Day

  • Paladin spellcasting begins at 5th level. Maximum spell level is 4th. Bonus spells from high Charisma apply once the Paladin is high enough level to cast that tier. No spells at 1st–4th level.
